mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_rag_chunk (id, question_id, chunk_index, source_type, title, content, embedding, metadata, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{questionId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{sourceType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{embedding}::vector, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, question_id AS questionId, chunk_index AS chunkIndex, source_type AS sourceType, title, content, metadata::text AS metadata, embedding <=> #{embedding}::vector AS distance FROM ai_rag_chunk ORDER BY embedding <=> #{embedding}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
